evidence.quote: **A 4.8× rate increase yields zero extra usable candidates** — every additional motif-bearing sample is an exact copy, and corpus copying rises 32.0% → 71.9%.
one template-free epoch took verbatim archetype copies from 37.9%→6.6% while corpus copies rose 31.6%→60.5% — **"the copying does not stop, it migrates."**
**"Removing structure relocates copying; adding structure dissolves it"**
what matters is still whether the channel carries structure the model has not memorised. Outcome labels are not that structure; the rows carrying them were.

rule: Move a generator by adding structure it has not memorised; never by steering, re-weighting or prompting it toward structure it already has.

applicability.applies: Every generator feedback channel: winners feedback, prefix conditioning, row re-weighting, outcome conditioning. Nine real ingested circuits (5.8% of training rows) bought +27 nb NDL where three steering channels bought none.
applicability.not: The law is about copying, not about rates -- the steering levers DO move the targeted statistic (motif rate 0.032 -> 0.926 under prefix control). They just buy no usable yield. Also, adding structure is not free: the same +27 NDL cost 11.4 points of structural yield and a wb inductor-ratio regression.
